subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should OpenClaw core sponsor TUI inline image rendering now, and if so must it be trusted-media-only with no arbitrary MEDIA text file reads?
rationale: The feature is useful and current main still lacks it, but terminal graphics, host file reads, fallback behavior, and the requested implementation boundary are maintainer product/security choices.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed trusted-media rebase
options.body: Keep this as the implementation candidate only if it is rebased to current attachments, fixes dedupe, removes arbitrary host MEDIA reads, and adds live terminal proof.

options.title: Defer core terminal graphics
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open or park this draft until maintainers decide terminal image rendering is a current core priority.

options.title: Close stale draft and retain tracker
options.body: Close this draft if maintainers do not want to sponsor a repair, while leaving the canonical issue for a clean future implementation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed trusted-media rebase
recommendation.body: Keep this as the implementation candidate only if it is rebased to current attachments, fixes dedupe, removes arbitrary host MEDIA reads, and adds live terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TUI renderer and adjacent image-generation feature history point to this owner as the best routing candidate for the product boundary decision.
